title: The Day the Silverware Took Root
description: On the first planting day, the kitchen sends its silverware out to the garden. By breakfast the forks have curled into shoots and a tarnished spoon is in bloom.
alt: A flowering stem winds around a silver spoon rooted in a broken pot. Forks sprout green curls in garden beds beneath a kitchen window.
pairing: First planting day × silverware that sprouts in a kitchen garden
